title: Tensor coherence under successive rational scalar extension
statement: Let l be prime, W a scheme with l invertible in each residue field, and E, L, M finite extensions of Q_l in the universe of W, with Q_l-algebra maps i:E→L and j:L→M. For X,Y in the raw rational constructible E-category of [def-sf-finite-rational-derived-operations], the tensor comparison for i followed by scalar extension along j, the tensor comparison for j, and the tensor of the two components of sfRationalScalarComp from [lem-weil-scalar-extension-composition] equals its component on X tensor Y followed by the tensor comparison for j composed with i. All functors and comparisons are the specific published normalized ones; no common-stage category or recorded stage system is involved.

source.place: scalarOperationsOrdinary_tower, tensor clause, followed by completion conjugation and rationalization in the common-stage tensor argument of def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom

proof.text: Apply the tensor clause of scalarOperationsOrdinary_tower to E, L, M and their actual inclusion maps. This supplies the ordinary tensor tower equation on every pair of derived objects.

Use uniqueness of the good-representative normalization to identify sfIntegralOrdinaryComparison with scalarCompletionIso on each intrinsic integral object. Expand sfIntegralScalarComp by its component specification. The private tensorTower_conjugate calculation uses naturality of scalarCompletion and scalarTensorOrdinary and cancels the consecutive completion inverses. Full faithfulness of the constructible inclusion then gives integralTensor_tower.

Apply sfRationalConstructibleLocalization to integralTensor_tower. The pure-tensor specifications of rational scalar extension and rationalDerivedTensor identify maps of integral arrows with their localized images. The component specifications of rationalTensorScalarComparison and sfRationalScalarComp identify the remaining factors. Heterogeneous congruence handles the prescribed object equalities, giving rationalTensor_tower. Package the categories and prescribed comparisons in rationalTensorTowerDatum and identify its Coherent predicate with this proved component equation.
